entities.name: Kuhnde
entities.description: A Jeskai monk and mantis rider who spent twenty years learning to ride his mantis and defends his monastery from a phoenix.

entities.name: Kuhnde's mantis
entities.description: The giant mantis Kuhnde has ridden for twenty years; it is burned fatally by the phoenix and killed by Kuhnde.

entities.name: The Phoenix
entities.description: A large fire bird the size of a mantis that hides inside a concealed amber orb and attacks the monastery.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir that controls the mountains and trains monks in many disciplines, including mantis riding.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where mantises grow larger than oxen.

entities.name: Jeskai monastery
entities.description: A mountain stronghold with a red-roofed tower from which Kuhnde watches the valley; its tallest tower houses a library of scrolls.

entities.name: Sage-Eye Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold whose master values stealth, quickness, and cunning.

entities.name: Dirgu Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold whose master teaches bladed weapons and balance with a spear.

entities.name: Riverwheel Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold that teaches its own variation of Riverwalk magic.

entities.name: Cori Mountain Stronghold
entities.description: A Jeskai stronghold whose master assesses Dragonfist maneuvers.

entities.name: School of Pearls
entities.description: A Jeskai school without a stronghold whose students manipulate pearls while fighting.

entities.name: Riverwalk
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates flowing water.

entities.name: Dragonfist
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the ancient hellkites.

entities.name: Flying Crane
entities.description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the wild aven of the high peaks.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir, here named for the great value it places on gold.

events.summary: Kuhnde, a Jeskai monk, stands atop his mantis on a tower and watches the valley, vigilant against the mount he rides.
events.quote: Atop a red-roofed Jeskai tower, a monk named Kuhnde stood on his mantis and looked over the valley.

events.summary: In a flashback, the young Kuhnde is tested by the masters of the strongholds and found competent in all disciplines, though expert in none, so they recognize him as suited to be a mantis rider.
events.quote: He was competent in all the disciplines, although not an expert, but they all recognized in Kuhnde the skill set that was required of being a mantis rider.

events.summary: In a flashback, Kuhnde meets his mount on the same day; a rider shows him how dangerous a mantis is when a freed tether lets it cut the rider's hand.
events.quote: The rider removed one of the mantis's tethers and the insect lashed out, cutting the rider's hand.

events.summary: Kuhnde's mantis alerts him to a concealed amber orb of energy racing up the mountain, and he signals the mantis to intercept it.
events.quote: Kuhnde's mantis turned its head, alerting him to movement near the base of the mountain.

events.summary: Kuhnde leads the orb away from the monastery toward the valley lakes, then turns back and jabs it with his spear.
events.quote: He signaled the mantis to go lower, so they could lead the energy ball away from the monastery.

events.summary: Kuhnde's spear thrust makes the orb dissipate, and a phoenix emerges and attacks.
events.quote: There was a loud screech, one the monks in the monastery would have heard, and the orb dissipated. A phoenix emerged and attacked.

events.summary: Kuhnde has the mantis take the phoenix's attack and the mantis wounds the phoenix, which flees toward the monastery's library tower.
events.quote: It cut the phoenix with its longer claws, and blood and flame emerged from the wound.

events.summary: Kuhnde resolves to protect the library's scrolls with his life, as the Jeskai prize their words above gold.
events.quote: Kuhnde would lay down his life protecting them.

events.summary: Kuhnde impales the phoenix with his spear, but its flames burn the mantis's wings and both creatures fall and slide down the mountainside.
events.quote: His mantis began to fall and he knew why before he saw—its wings were burning.

events.summary: Kuhnde finds his mantis of twenty years dying and still trying to kill him.
events.quote: He approached it, his companion for twenty years, as it lay dying.

events.summary: Kuhnde kills his dying mantis with his spear to end its misery.
events.quote: With a quick, precise motion, Kuhnde impaled the mantis's head to end its misery

events.summary: Kuhnde decides against killing the injured phoenix, since it would only be reborn stronger; he rights it and strikes its beak with his spear shaft, beginning to tame it.
events.quote: He had never learned how to tame a phoenix, but he knew, given the time, he would master a new way.

relations.note: Kuhnde is a Jeskai monk and mantis rider.
relations.quote: Atop a red-roofed Jeskai tower, a monk named Kuhnde stood on his mantis and looked over the valley.

relations.note: He ends the burned mantis's misery with his spear.
relations.quote: With a quick, precise motion, Kuhnde impaled the mantis's head to end its misery

relations.note: Kuhnde fights the phoenix that threatens the monastery, then sets out to tame it.
relations.quote: It was still a threat to the monastery, even injured, and killing it would only cause it to be reborn, stronger even.

relations.note: A Jeskai stronghold, one of several training sites.
relations.quote: while the master of Dirgu Stronghold brought with him several bladed weapons for Kuhnde to use
